items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: and a dancer named Peg Leg Bates.

ctx.x: I don't think so. But I've got to -- Linton worked with Timmy Rogers, and I didn't get a chance to really know Linton that well until the Big Show of 1951, that

first big package show. Remember the one that had Duke's band and the Marie Bryant dancers. King Cole was the headliner, Nat King Cole. I was with Sarah Vaughan. And we had -- Duke was the emcee, and we had Patterson and Jackson, comedians, Timmy Rogers, and then Stump and Stumpy, some more comedians, you know, and a dancer named Peg Leg Bates.
